reviews.review:
Dropped this game. I had no trouble getting the game to run, but the troubles begin there... 

[b]The Good[/b]
- runs smoothly
- existing mechanics function properly
- voice acting exists and it's not too bad
- soundtrack isn't bad

[b]The Bad[/b]
- average -> ugly character models
- existing gameplay feels clunky 
- excessively punishing deaths that brings in the boredom quickly

There is a story and it might be interesting, but each stage of is painful to play. If you die, you have to redo everything from the beginning of the stage. This may not sound too bad, but the bare-minimum mechanics just make the experience  rather boring.

I surrender to the grind.
